treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1993, as amended by Protocol 2012)
eif_quote: Whereas the annexed Agreement between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan ... has entered into force on the 25th January, 1994 ... Notification : No. SO 790(E), dated 13-11-1996.
source_title: Wayback copy (2012) of Income Tax Department of India (law.incometaxindia.gov.in) text of Notification SO 790(E) with annexed 1993 India-Uzbekistan Agreement; 2012 Protocol read from secondary reproduction (taxguru.in) of Notification No. 49/2012, SO 2689(E) dated 7-11-2012

rates.article: Article 10(2) as amended by Article 1 of the 2012 Protocol
rates.quote: [Art. 10(2) 1993] ... but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of gross amount of the dividends. || [Protocol 2012, Art. 1] In paragraph 2 of Article 10(Dividends) of the Agreement, the number and words "15 per cent" shall substituted by the number and words "10 per cent".

rates.article: Article 11(2) as amended by Article 2 of the 2012 Protocol
rates.quote: [Art. 11(2) 1993] ... but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the interest. || [Protocol 2012, Art. 2] In paragraph 2 of Article 11 (Interest) of the Agreement, the number and words "15 per cent" shall substituted by the number and words "10 per cent".

rates.article: Article 12(2) as amended by Article 3 of the 2012 Protocol
rates.quote: [Art. 12(2) 1993] ... but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of gross amount of the royalties. || [Protocol 2012, Art. 3] In paragraph 2 of Article 12(Royalties) of the Agreement, the number and words "15 per cent" shall substituted by the number and words "10 per cent".

ppt.quote: ARTICLE 28B LIMITATION OF BENEFITS ... 2. A resident of a Contracting State shall not be entitled to the benefits of this Agreement if its affairs were arranged in such a manner as if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes to take the benefits of this Agreement. 3. The case of legal entities not having bona fide business activities shall be covered by the provisions of this Article.

notes: 2012 Protocol signed Tashkent 11-04-2012, entered into force 20-07-2012 (Notification No. 49/2012, SO 2689(E) dated 7-11-2012). Protocol Art. 7: effect in India for income derived in fiscal years beginning on or after 1 April following entry into force -> FY 2013-14 (2013-04-01, as the notification states); in Uzbekistan for years beginning on or after 1 January 2013 (valid_from uses the Indian-side date). Before that, 15% caps applied to dividends, interest and royalties from India FY 1993-94 / Uzbekistan 1993 (Art. 30). Art. 13 technical fees also reduced 15% -> 10% (not modelled). Art. 11(3): interest exempt for Government, political sub-divisions, local authorities and Central Bank of the other State, and (to the extent approved) Government-approved loans - not modelled. Art. 28B (India's MLI position lists Uzbekistan Art. 28B(2)-(3) as an existing Art. 7(2) provision) is a main-purpose test, recorded as treaty PPT on the Indian-side date (Uzbek side 2013-01-01); Art. 28B(1) preserves domestic anti-avoidance rules. Uzbekistan is not an MLI signatory. The 1993 Agreement text is from an archived official Indian page; the 2012 Protocol text is from a secondary reproduction of the Indian notification (official Gazette/ITD copy not reachable: incometaxindia.gov.in 403, no Wayback capture; lex.uz text not located).
